d.seg: दायर्ॅक पेमेंट करूँ तो हमको क्या क्या आपको पेटीएम
d.tr: If I make a direct payment then what... Paytm you...
d.ctx: The user asks about paying directly and mentions Paytm, to which the expert responds.
d.j: Proposing payment via an external app/service, matching the strong PlatformMove case.

d.tr: Shall I do Paytm directly now, then will you talk on that? Yes, money has to be added now, will you do video call?
